| **`RuleEvaluator`** | Recursive-descent parser for the grammar `expr → and → cmp → atom`. Only comparison and logical operators are possible. |
| **`resolveToken()`** | Reads `ctx.<key>` values via `Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty` — blocks `__proto__`, `constructor`, `prototype` access explicitly. |
| **`evalRule()`** | Validates length (≤ 2048 chars), calls tokeniser, runs evaluator, asserts all tokens were consumed (no trailing garbage). |
| **`POST /check`** | Returns `{ result: true\|false }` on success, `{ error: "..." }` with HTTP 400 on any invalid input. |

### Supported rule syntax

```
ctx.amount > 100
ctx.status == 'active'
ctx.score >= 90 && ctx.tier != 'free'
(ctx.role == 'admin' || ctx.score > 500) && ctx.verified == true
```
